title: PR #186: fix(registry): exclude specification-only cross-chain bindings
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Summary

Corrects the WP-M0 runtime-symbol registry blocker found in workflow run 38812071575 (job 116687495451).

- Clears the non-executable `source_path` and `symbol_or_entrypoint` values for `FN-XCHAIN-001..003`; the contracts remain specification-only and unimplemented.
- Makes the registry builder explicitly ignore bindings marked `binding_kind=specification_only` or `status=SPECIFICATION_ONLY_NO_IMPLEMENTATION_BINDING`, so stale placeholder text cannot become executable source evidence.
- Adds a regression test proving specification-only placeholders do not create catalog bindings or duplicate-binding blockers.

## Evidence and acceptance

- Source baseline: `417a30cd31e52a7f42e03ac1329e446182e1ea5f`
- Original failure: https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/38812071575/job/116687495451
- This PR does not claim functional verification or CP0 acceptance. The runtime registry must rebuild and validate successfully on the updated commit; overall status remains BLOCKED until CI evidence and independent review are complete.
- Stacked on the architecture catalog work branch; review and merge order must preserve the parent change.
